This mission requires that you destroy four Academy target ships in this system, but this time their weapons will do some damage to your ship. Make sure you avoid their fire while trying to destroy them. Try not to hit any other ships, however, for they may begin to attack you as well. Watch your shields - if you run into trouble, land on Levo. Your shields will be recharged, and when you leave, you will be able to continue the mission. Remember only shoot at the ships that are RED.
